column1: # Rows db.flh.tbn.* (F-LH, 2026-11-21): a PSSM query (-in_pssm) whose Bioseq Seq-ids repeat, where the object manager's "duplicate Bioseq id" exception writes the repeated accession by the Seq-id that made the info of its packed key (prefix without case, digit count, version): another number of the info first (c01 c02 c03 c08 c09 c10 c12 c13), the leading-zero adjustment of more than 6 digits (r08), version 0 on both sides (r10), the Seq-table's default id making the info (r12), and the controls (another version, digit count or prefix, the duplicate's own number first, an accession with a name, a third-party accession, 7 real digits r09, version 0 against none r11); NCBI 2.17.0 -num_threads 1.

column12: F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): another number of the info's prefix, digit count and version came first (EMBL): the duplicate GenBank accession is written with that Seq-id's alternative
F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): a DDBJ accession of another number first: the duplicate is written as dbj|
F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): the duplicate in another case: the first's alternative, each id its own case
F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): control: another version is another info (own alternative)

F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): the leading-zero adjustment: emb|AAA0000012 first, gb|AAA0000111 twice: more than 6 digits move their zeros into the prefix, so both have the prefix AAA0 and 7 digits, one info, written as emb|

F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): control: emb|AAA1000012 has 7 real digits (prefix AAA, no adjustment): its own info, the duplicate is written as gb|
F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): version 0 on both sides: the version is set, one info, written as emb| (no version in the text)
F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): control: version 0 against no version: another info, the duplicate is written as gb|

F-LH (an info of a packed Seq-id is made by the first Seq-id of its prefix, digit count and version): the default Seq-id of a Seq-table column (emb|AAA00002.1) makes the info before the Bioseqs' gb|AAA00001.1 are met: written as emb|
